charts.title: K2-330 b: orbits around K2-330
charts.description: The orbits of K2-330's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-330 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 13.7748361 d

charts.title: K2-330 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-330 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 366484980, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 14 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 18-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
